messages:
Maya: Deploy window: checkout-fastpath v2.0.0 -> rolling behind feature flag `fastpath_v2` in us-central at 02:00 UTC. Dark launch to internal traffic first. Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/2.0.0
Omar: What's the exact rollout rhythm? We should avoid big jumps during peak support hours.
Priya: Rhythm: dark launch 0.5% internal -> 2% internal -> 5% internal -> 15% population -> silent burst to 50% -> 100%. Gates: 8m at 0.5%, 12m at 2%, 20m at 5%, 25m at 15%. Silent burst (15%->50%->100%) does 10m checks between jumps.
Quinn: Pinning: mobile-app cohort (cohort: mobile-beta) stays on v1.x until we confirm session resume stability. We'll annotate service with routing.pin=mobile-beta.
Maya: Copy. I'll kick off the deploy and pin mobile cohort.
releasebot: Release note posted to #docs and #product. Summary: faster checkout decisioning; known edge: token refresh race in <0.1% of sessions.
deploybot: Preparing rollout: target=checkout-fastpath, region=us-central, sha=bbbccc111, version=2.0.0. Flag=fastpath_v2. Starting dark launch 0.5% internal.
Maya: `kubectl annotate svc checkout-fastpath routing.pin=mobile-beta` -> applied.
Omar: Observing metrics: dark 0.5% looks fine. No increase in 5xx. p95 +1.8%.
Priya: After 8m, expand to 2%.
deploybot: feature flag `fastpath_v2` changed: 0% -> 0.5% (internal). Health checks green.
Quinn: Moving to 2% now.
deploybot: feature flag `fastpath_v2` changed: 0.5% -> 2% (internal).
Omar: Small spike in auth-service retries from one AZ (az-3). Investigating.
Maya: Can we retry auth-service sidecar restart? Might be transient.
Priya: I'll trigger restart on az-3 momentarily.
Priya: Restarted sidecar pool in az-3. Retries cleared. Proceeding to 5% after the 12m soak.
deploybot: feature flag `fastpath_v2` changed: 2% -> 5%.
Omar: At 5% I see a 0.6% 5xx vs baseline 0.3%. p95 +9%. Under threshold but watching.
Quinn: Gate to 15% once the 20m soak completes, unless error budget shifts.
Maya: Reminder: auto-fallback route-to=v1 enabled if p95 > 350ms for 2 min.
releasebot: Update: release channel updated with rollback steps and `kubectl` commands.
Priya: Expanding to 15% now.
deploybot: feature flag `fastpath_v2` changed: 5% -> 15%. Canary cohort widened.
Omar: Hmm seeing a pattern: increase in DB transaction retries for a specific query used by gamified checkout. Investigating query plan.
Priya: Which query? Postgres slowlog shows repeated index scan on orders_temp. I'll patch a hint to use idx_orders_state.
Priya: Patch applied, rolling restart to pick up plan.
Omar: Post-patch retries dropped. p95 back near baseline. Good to continue.
Quinn: Proceed to silent burst: 15% -> 50% (10m wait) -> 100%.
Maya: Launching burst. Leave pin for mobile-beta for 60m post-rollout.
deploybot: feature flag `fastpath_v2` changed: 15% -> 50%. Waiting 10m gate.
Omar: After burst to 50% we saw a tiny uptick in CAS contention on one DB replica. Not critical but correlated with heavy cart flows.
Priya: Offloading reads from that replica and pushing jobs to replica-2. Contention eased.
deploybot: feature flag `fastpath_v2` changed: 50% -> 100%. Full rollout complete. No auto-fallback triggered.
Quinn: Unpin mobile-beta after 60m if everything stays stable.
Maya: Logging final timestamps in the deploy ticket and linking all incident/runbook notes.
releasebot: Release published: https://redwood.dev/releases/2.0.0 — includes mitigations and post-deploy checklist.
Omar: I'll do a 45m watch and report back if error budget approaches.
Priya: Thanks all. If any regressions appear, immediate drain to 0% and pin back to 1.x is the plan.
Quinn: Nice coordinated rollout 389
Maya: Closing ticket in 1h if no issues.
